Hey everyone,
I’m looking to see if anyone can share a high-quality copy of Sabrina Carpenter's Short n' Sweet (preferably FLAC or Apple Lossless, but high-bitrate MP3/M4A is totally fine too!).
I am specifically looking for a custom Deluxe Expanded version that includes the physical bonus track, the demo, and a few specific instrumentals.
Here is what I'm hoping to get:
* **Album:** Short n' Sweet (Deluxe Edition)
* **Bonus Tracks & Extras Added:**
* Needless To Say (Physical Bonus Track)
* Taste (Demo Version)
* Espresso (Instrumental)
* Please Please Please (Instrumental)
* Taste (Instrumental)
* Bed Chem (Instrumental)
* Juno (Instrumental)
Since Busy Woman was officially released, I keep founding someone which compile it to 24 tracks.

If anyone has this put together, or has the individual high-quality files to share so I can compile it myself, I would appreciate it so much!
Thank you in advance!
